sections.heading: What It Holds
paragraphs: At 36cm tall the Marble Effect Ellipse Large Vase suits stems of roughly 54cm overall — the rule of thumb florists work to is an arrangement about half again as tall as the vessel holding it. A supermarket bunch arrives longer than that, so expect to take a third off the bottom before it sits properly. Cut on a slant, and the stems draw water better and last several days longer.

If you want a looser, more sculptural look, work with fewer stems of varying height rather than filling it.

sections.heading: Worth Knowing
paragraphs: It weighs 44kg, which is a two-person lift — worth arranging help for the day it arrives.

sections.heading: In the Room
paragraphs: Allow around 75cm clear in front for a comfortable walkway — the figure building regulations use for a circulation route — so the 45cm width really wants about 195cm of wall to sit without the room feeling tight. Measure the route in as well as the space it lands in; a piece this size has to get through the door and round the turn of a stair.
Its 45cm depth is the number that decides whether a room still works around it. In a hallway or behind a sofa, anything much past 40cm starts to catch shoulders and bags as people pass.

sections.heading: Delivery
paragraphs: Dispatched within 3–4 weeks, with free UK delivery.
